title: 第5章 能量同化大获丰收第6章 掌控梦境空间的可能
slug: 虚实梦境之主从死后开始
content_zh:
看着突然来到面前的陌生人，楚泽涛微微皱眉。
“滚滚滚，没看到本大爷正和美女探讨人生呢吗？”
“……”
孟天有些无语。
虽然进入梦境的只是分身，并不能对其造成任何伤害，虽然如今的胖子意识大部分沉沦。
但是这般，是不是也太不将他放在眼中了？
“桀桀桀...”
孟天猛的咧嘴，发出一阵阴森诡笑。
“卧槽！”
看着突然发出怪笑的孟天，楚泽天被吓了一跳，一个乒乓球大小的光球，忽地飞出他的身体。
“呃…”
看着那个光球，孟天也是忍不住的心中一突，生怕胖子被惊醒。
实在是掉落的梦境能量只有乒乓球大小，也太少了点。
如果就掉落这些能量，那实在有些亏了。
只不过，那胖子被吓了一跳之后，却并没有梦境崩溃苏醒，反而是一下子站起，骂骂咧咧的向着孟天走来。
“你小子找死啊，鬼笑什么鬼笑？”
“你是说我吗？”
孟天裂开的嘴巴越张越大，森然的声音幽幽回荡。
最终...
“嗤啦！”

自嘴角开始，孟天的脸部整个撕裂开来，一股股的鲜血喷溅开来。
“卧槽，鬼啊！”
楚泽涛被吓了一跳，惊恐大叫出声，周围空间都在剧烈的扭曲。
与此同时，一颗拳头大小的光球，飞出其身体。
楚泽涛毫不犹豫的转身便逃。
不过，在其看到那些同样花容失色的美女之后，楚泽涛的动作却又微微一顿。
“你们快走，你们快走！”
楚泽涛一边说着，一边快速摆手。
并且，楚泽涛不退反进，反而向着孟天冲来。
“卧槽！”
看着楚泽涛的行为，孟天都惊了。
而更让他震惊的是，本来剧烈波动的空间，此时竟然重新稳定了下来。
一时之间，孟天都不知道该说眼前胖子意志坚定，还是该说他色胆包天了。
不过...
看着急冲而来的胖子，孟天哪还管他什么情况，整个人身体一闪，瞬间来到了胖子身后。
以他如今身体的力量，可扛不住胖子的冲击。
就像先前的外卖员，别说攻击了，就只是本能的防御，就能将他击飞出去。
不过，闪避却是没有问题的。
如今的孟天，就是一团精神能量，虽然在梦境虚空，其他人的梦境空间，做不到无视距离的念动而至。
但是做到轻若飘絮，躲避胖子的攻击，却还是完全没有问题的。

当然了，这是因为胖子并没有意识到，这里乃是他的梦境。
否则的话，瞬间就能将孟天镇压了。
content_en:
Looking at the stranger who suddenly came in front of him, Chu Zetao frowned slightly.
"Gungun, don't you see that this uncle is discussing life with a beautiful woman?"
"..."
Meng Tian was speechless.
Although it is only the clone that enters the dream, it cannot cause any harm to it, although most of the fat man's consciousness is now sinking.
But in this way, is it too little to take him seriously?
"Jiejiejie..."
Meng Tian fiercely grinned and let out a sinister smile.
"Fuck!"
Looking at Meng Tian who suddenly laughed strangely, Chu Zetian was startled. A ball of light the size of a table tennis ball suddenly flew out of his body.
"Uh..."
Looking at the ball of light, Meng Tian couldn't help but feel a sudden thought in his heart, for fear that the fat man would be awakened.
In fact, the dream energy that fell was only the size of a ping pong ball, which was too little.
If you just drop this energy, it would be a bit of a loss.
However, after the fat man was startled, he did not collapse from his dream and wake up. Instead, he stood up and walked towards Meng Tian cursing.
"You're looking for death, why are you laughing?"
"Are you talking about me?"
Meng Tian's gaping mouth opened wider and wider, and his sinister voice echoed faintly.
Finally...
"Tsk!"
Starting from the corner of his mouth, Meng Tian's face was torn apart, and streams of blood splattered out.
"What the hell, what a ghost!"
Chu Zetao was startled and screamed in horror. The surrounding space was violently distorted.
At the same time, a fist-sized ball of light flew out of his body.
Chu Zetao turned around and ran away without hesitation.
However, after seeing those beauties with equally beautiful faces, Chu Zetao paused slightly.
"Go quickly, go quickly!"
Chu Zetao waved his hands quickly as he spoke.
Moreover, Chu Zetao did not retreat but advanced, and instead rushed towards Meng Tian.
"Fuck!"
Seeing Chu Zetao's behavior, Meng Tian was shocked.
What shocked him even more was that the space that had been fluctuating violently now stabilized again.
For a moment, Meng Tian didn't know whether to say that the fat man in front of him was determined or that he was cowardly.
But...
Looking at the fat man rushing towards him, Meng Tiantian didn't care what his situation was. His whole body flashed and he was behind the fat man in an instant.
With the strength of his current body, he could not withstand the impact of the fat man.
Just like the delivery man before, let alone attack, just instinctive defense can knock him away.
However, dodging is no problem.
Today's Meng Tian is just a ball of spiritual energy. Although he is in the void of dreams and other people's dream spaces, he cannot reach him with his thoughts regardless of the distance.
But being as light as a piece of catkins and avoiding the fat man's attacks was no problem at all.
Of course, this is because the fat man did not realize that this was his dream.
Otherwise, Meng Tian could be suppressed in an instant.
